name: BME280 humidity, pressure and temperature sensor
description: Bosch BME280 combined sensor on I2C (0x76/0x77 from SDO) or SPI: chip ID 0x60, sleep, forced and normal modes, oversampling x1 to x16, the IIR filter and standby times, trimming parameters that Bosch's compensation formulas turn into degrees, pascals and %RH. Temperature, pressure and humidity are interactive inputs.

pins.name: CSB
pins.doc: SPI chip select, active low; tie high for I2C (low once selects SPI until power-down)

pins.name: SDI
pins.doc: I2C SDA (open drain) or SPI data in

pins.name: SDO
pins.doc: I2C address bit 0 (0x76 low, 0x77 high) or SPI data out

outputs.name: interface
outputs.doc: i2c, or spi once CSB has gone low

functional.claims: I2C at 0x76 + SDO with address/data pairs and auto-incrementing reads; 4-wire SPI (mode 0) once CSB goes low, I2C then off until power-down; the register map with chip ID 0x60, soft reset, ctrl_hum applied by ctrl_meas, status (measuring, im_update), config ignored in normal mode; sleep, forced and normal modes with the typical measurement time and the standby times; raw values that Bosch's compensation turns into the inputs at the oversampling's resolution, the IIR filter on temperature and pressure, skipped measurements as 0x80000/0x8000, shadowed data registers; no answer below 1.71 V.
omissions: the noise the oversampling averages (readings exact to the resolution)
the accuracy spread between parts (+-1 C, +-1 hPa, +-3 %RH)
the humidity response time (1 s) and self-heating
